specification.rule: All specification build errors and warnings are considered critical until explicitly reclassified.

python-specification-controls.rule: Only diagnostics with a justified source location are annotated. Global failures remain in the report.

reuse.rule: File-level REUSE violations are annotated; the complete REUSE report remains authoritative.

implementation.rule: Only errors are annotated by default.

documentation-and-auxiliary.rule: Failures remain in GitHub Actions reports unless a future policy promotes them.
